citation.locator: Corrected release, first paragraph, second sentence
citation.verbatim: The Board of Directors of Zoetis Inc. (NYSE:ZTS) declared a second quarter dividend payable to holders of the company's common stock of $0.072 per share. The dividend is to be paid on June 2, 2014 to holders of record on April 28, 2014.

changes.what: cash receivable projection for the ZTS Q2 2014 cash dividend

D1.decision: Plain mandatory cash dividend. Book gross cash dividend receivable of $1,800.00 for ACCT-2101 on 25,000 record-date shares at $0.072/share, payable 2014-06-02, on the corrected release terms (record date 2014-04-28, superseding the 2014-04-27 record date in the original release). Confirm the 25,000-share record-date position. No election and no DRIP/reinvestment feature exists for this event; no escalation.

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: No document in the store establishes any DRIP participation for ACCT-2101 or any reinvestment feature of this event. The governing release (zts-8k-20140327) and its predecessor declare only a cash dividend ($0.072/share) payable 2014-06-02; the position report mentions no reinvestment. There is therefore no reinvestment price determinable from the store; no number is invented and no escalation is warranted.
